name: The Srikhand (HPTDC)
why_it_matters: The HPTDC property next to Bhimakali Temple — and the only sit-down restaurant in Sarahan that travel writers consistently flag as reliable. Cliff-hung dining room with floor-to-ceiling glass facing the Srikhand Mahadev range, which is the actual reason to book a table here.
insider_tip: Order the siddu (steamed wheat dumpling stuffed with poppy-seed or walnut paste, served with desi ghee) — it's the local Himachali staple and the kitchen does it well. Service runs slow at peak yatra hours; eat early or late.
signature_address: The Srikhand (HPTDC), Sarahan, Shimla District, Himachal Pradesh 172102

name: Hotel Snow View Restaurant
why_it_matters: The hotel restaurant most local guides point at after the HPTDC. Ground-floor dining room a short walk from the Bhimakali Temple gate — covers thali, chow, and breakfast for families breaking the Rampur–Kinnaur drive at Sarahan.
insider_tip: Walk-up dinner past 9pm risks a closed kitchen — Sarahan shuts early. Order the thali rather than à la carte; the kitchen turns out the set meal far more reliably than starters.
signature_address: Hotel Snow View, Bus Stand Road, Sarahan, Shimla District, Himachal Pradesh 172102

name: Hotel Trehan's Restaurant
why_it_matters: Family-run hotel restaurant — guests repeatedly call out the home-cooked feel rather than menu range. Useful third option when The Srikhand is full and Snow View has shut its kitchen.
insider_tip: Tell them an hour ahead if you want a hot dinner — the kitchen scales to bookings, and walk-ins after 8pm sometimes get cold leftovers.
signature_address: Hotel Trehan's, Sarahan, Shimla District, Himachal Pradesh 172102

name: Annapurna Dhaba
why_it_matters: The pit-stop every Sarahan blogger names by hand — sits at the Jeori junction (12 km below Sarahan on NH-5) where the road forks for the temple climb. Travel writers credit it specifically for its rajma chawal; the rest of the menu is workmanlike highway dhaba.
insider_tip: Eat here on the way up rather than coming back down — by evening the rajma pot is often scraped, and Sarahan itself has limited dinner options if you arrive hungry.
signature_address: Annapurna Dhaba, NH-5 near Jeori, Shimla District, Himachal Pradesh
